description: Connect your WordPress evidence plugin (optional): its HTTPS endpoint URL and the secret it generated. The secret is stored encrypted, then a signed health check sets the integration state. Without the plugin RepuTend runs on Trustpilot's public signals. (capability: evidence.manage_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: set_evidence_endpoint
